## Offered pilot
$79 fixed, up to 3 written-authorized staging HTTP checks, optional offline sanitized n8n/A2A metadata review, HTML/JSON evidence, prioritized notes. Contact briefflowge@gmail.com. No production data or API keys in initial contact.

## Limitations
No security certification, full LLM reliability guarantee, production changes, or automated payment. No customer has been audited yet.
